resources.string: Optional quiet timer and stopwatch controls

Optional and off by default. Shows countdown or elapsed time and controls. Supported Android versions may promote a running clock to a Live Update; Android and your settings decide. Paused clocks use ordinary notifications. Stopwatch Reset opens a confirmation.
Hidden for this countdown. Completion alerts are unaffected.
Timer and stopwatch status notifications are blocked in Android settings. Completion alerts have a separate channel.
